recommendation.rationale: Tracked beat start with 8.475 seconds of low-energy lead-in before the detected drop, then 26.525 seconds of sustained high energy, including the second peak section beginning 46.370. The lead-in is a lower-energy plateau, not an algorithmically detected rising build.

matching_existing_words.source_match_evidence: transcribe_align.py has the exact AUDIO path as MP3 and writes this words.json

caveats: Onsets use librosa onset detection frames (hop 128 / 22050 = 5.805 ms). An attack envelope maximum or perceived attack may be a few frames later than the reported detection.
Beat times are variable librosa-tracked events, not synthesized repeated early-region beats. BPM is an approximate global summary.
Downbeats are every fourth tracked beat, not a validated meter/downbeat classifier.
Music section labels are relative percentile heuristics: the 32.345-46.370 mid section has 0.895 mean energy, almost identical to labeled peaks.
No rising build was labeled. The excerpt supplies low-to-high contrast instead.
Existing word alignment is unverified and may contain zero-duration or weakly aligned words; it was not used to place impacts.
